explication: Cotabby is a macOS-wide, local-first autocomplete app. Its main workflow observes typing and the focused field, builds a contextual suggestion request, routes generation to the selected engine, then presents ghost text for wordwise acceptance or dismissal. Separate inline features provide emoji completion and macros; settings cover engines and model downloads, while optional screen context and spelling support enrich writing assistance. README documents these capabilities; sampled runtime source confirms engine routing and backend adaptation, but coordinator wiring is not fully shown in the excerpts.
